places-xanten-furstenberg-cologne-cathed.story: 333 km from Xanten to Xanten, about 5 h 44 of riding. The stops in between: Moers-Asberg, Zollverein Coal Mine Industrial Complex in, Neuss-Reckberg | Wachtturm and Cologne Cathedral. The line favours views over speed.
